evidence.quote:
# Sound Trail 2027

Sound Trail is a music festival at Meadow Grounds, York, United Kingdom, on 23–30 January 2027. These are confirmed programme dates.

- Three-concert pass: GBP 9.99. Access to three paid concerts of your choice; it does not cover the full programme. Other activities are free. Sales availability is not stated.
- Stay package: GBP 899. Includes lodging and the Three-concert pass only. It does not include full-programme admission. Sales availability is not stated.

- All-programme pass: $615.35. The currency selector is missing from this page; no country or currency code is given for this price. This site serves multiple countries. Sales availability is not stated.
